checkpoint_provenance.migration_basis: Owner selected chat-led simulation with GitHub persistence. Explicitly recover the latest retained 500-USDT account checkpoint; both later journal records contain zero fills. This is a documented journal migration, not a claim that a local runtime is deployed or monitored.

decisions.rationale: No approved CORE model is available. Fresh market data and account capacity permit the unchanged BTC ATR14 exploration fallback required by the owner. The entry is exploratory and does not claim predictive alpha.
decisions.alternative_rejected: Inventing balances, stale-price fills, or continuous protection.

review.causality: No attribution of profitability to a single round; open positions have pending outcomes.
review.finding: Review uses current executable bid only. Open positions remain pending outcomes; initial costs and current price movement are separated from realized results. No intervening exit times reconstructed.

improvement.hypothesis: Tracking entry costs and available cash alongside observed lot outcomes identifies capacity constraints and whether eventual gross outcomes cover costs.
improvement.activity: Separate gross price movement on carried lots from the new entry fee/spread and accrued borrowing interest. Recompute financing-inclusive planned risk, net reward and debt continuity; retain baseline pending closed outcomes.
improvement.forward_experiment: Continue unchanged BTC ATR14 exploration sampler; assess realized net outcomes against modeled costs once positions close.
improvement.rollback_condition: Accounting, freshness or capacity violations block admission; preserve history and append corrections.

margin_assumptions.exit_model: OBSERVED_BID_WITH_COSTS_AND_SHARED_DEPTH; delayed observations may exceed planned loss or financing reserve
